items.title: Template Engine Injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0), dubbed BlockStrap, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. This vulnerability was fixed in the October 2026 security update.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in B2B
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.8) in Adobe Commerce B2B allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. This was part of the APSB26-153 bulletin.

items.title: Template Engine Injection (StyleSmuggler) - Zero-Day RCE
items.summary: A critical zero-day template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0), dubbed StyleSmuggler, allowed unauthenticated remote code execution and was actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this issue.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities including Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, including critical stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and incorrect authorization issues, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Six of these vulnerabilities are exploitable without authentication.

items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) allows attackers to take over customer accounts without prior authentication or user interaction. This vulnerability was added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.
